items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What about today, when you hear someone like Oscar Petersen? Is that too far out for you? [INTERVIEWEE] Oscar Petersen? ... Those men fit in just at a time when they needed them.
